text.title: Single Channel Bet Selector — Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps from a founder with no working channel to a dated, validated channel bet: confirm no channel already produces revenue and the ICP sample is large enough, list 3 to 6 tactic-level candidates from the Traction taxonomy, score founder fit, ICP density with its sample count and early traction, apply the 12-of-15 threshold and per-axis floor, commit to one channel for 90 days and park the rest, write the weekly unit, checkpoints and kill criterion on the same day, then validate and store the rubric.

step.name: confirm-no-working-channel-and-the-icp-sample
step.input: Revenue by source for the last 3 months; the list of paying customers and qualified conversations.
step.action: Record `working_channel_exists` (false only if no channel yields at least one paying customer a month) and `icp_sample` with `paying_customers` and `qualified_conversations`.
step.decision-gate: A channel already producing revenue: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml and keep executing it; fewer than 5 customers and 50 conversations: run discovery first (r-icp-density-cites-sample).

step.name: list-tactic-level-candidates
step.input: Traction's 19 channels; the founder's weekly calendar; where customers said they found the product.
step.action: Write 3 to 6 `candidates[]`, each `channel` at the tactic level the founder would execute ("LinkedIn founder posts on ops-team tooling", not "social") with its `taxonomy_channel`.
step.decision-gate: Fewer than 3 candidates ratifies a prior choice; more than 6 defers it; category-level entries cannot be scored on founder fit (r-candidate-set-from-named-list).

step.name: score-the-three-axes-with-samples
step.input: The candidate list; the customer and conversation sample; inbound lead and sale records per channel.
step.action: Score each candidate 1 to 5 on `founder_fit`, `icp_density` (with `icp_density_sample` {observed, of} counted from the sample, or null and a score of 1) and `early_traction` (with `unsolicited_inbound_count`); set `total` to the sum. No weights, no fourth axis.
step.decision-gate: A density score without an observed-of-sample count is recorded as 1 (r-three-axis-scoring, r-icp-density-cites-sample).

step.name: apply-the-threshold-and-per-axis-floor
step.action: Set `clears_bar` on each candidate: total at least 12 and every axis at least 3. If none clears, set `outcome: no_bet`, `bet: null` and `no_bet_route` (discovery, or instrument_highest_scorer with the top total); otherwise `outcome: bet`.
step.decision-gate: A high total with one axis at 1 or 2 is rejected regardless of total; the least-bad option is not a bet (r-threshold-12-of-15-and-per-axis-floor).

step.name: commit-to-one-channel-and-park-the-rest
step.action: Fill `bet.channel` with one clearing candidate, `start_date` and `end_date` exactly 90 days later; list every other candidate in `parking_lot.channels[]` with its `total` and set `active_work_allowed: false`.
step.decision-gate: Two channels, or new weekly effort on a parked channel during the 90 days, voids the bet (r-one-channel-parking-lot).

step.name: write-the-weekly-unit-checkpoints-and-kill-criterion
step.input: The chosen channel's countable unit of work; the leading indicators it produces.
step.action: On the same day as the selection, write `bet.weekly_unit` {count, unit}, `checkpoints[]` at week 4 and week 8 each with a `metric` and numeric `expected`, and `kill_criterion` for week 12 with `written_on` = `selected_on`, numeric `conditions[]`, `action` rerun_rubric_with_result_as_early_traction and `revised: false`.
step.decision-gate: A checkpoint miss triggers a written execution adjustment, never a channel switch before week 12; a revised kill criterion is recorded as a failed bet (r-weekly-unit-and-checkpoints, r-precommitted-kill-criterion).

step.name: store-the-rubric-and-validate
step.action: Write the single-page rubric from the template, commit it to version control or a dated document and record the path in `rubric_location`. Run `scripts/validate-single-channel-bet-selector.py --file` on the record; the 90-day clock starts only when it passes.
step.decision-gate: A verbal or chat-only decision does not start the clock (r-written-rubric-single-page).

list.item: Record validates via `scripts/validate-single-channel-bet-selector.py` with no violation, including score sums, the threshold and floor, the 90-day window and the kill criterion date.
The rubric is stored at `rubric_location` and dated `selected_on`; the founder can re-read it at week 12.
Week-4, week-8 and week-12 dates are in the calendar with their numbers.
